answers.core: I don't know if an addon would really even be helpful here.
answers.workaround: I don't know if it can be worked around in the editor, but the current way of configuring for example a third person camera is to attach the camera to the spring arm, put your character in a scene with lights, run the scene, adjust the spring arm as needed while alt tabbing back to the running game and keep tweaking until it's perfect. It's quite clunky.
